arc.add.description: Draws an arc through three points, from a centre, radius and start and end angles, or from start, centre and end points.

arc.addCenterStartAngle.description: Draws an arc about a centre from a start point through an included angle in degrees.

arc.addCenterStartEnd.description: Draws a counter-clockwise arc about a centre from a start point to the angle of an end point.

arc.addCenterStartLength.description: Draws an arc about a centre from a start point with the given chord length.

arc.addContinue.description: Draws an arc tangent to the end of the last line or arc drawn, to an end point, or from a start point and direction.

arc.addStartCenterAngle.description: Draws an arc from a start point about a centre through an included angle; positive angles go counter-clockwise.

arc.addStartCenterEnd.description: Draws a counter-clockwise arc from a start point about a centre to the angle of an end point.

arc.addStartCenterLength.description: Draws an arc from a start point about a centre with the given chord length; a negative length draws the major arc.

arc.addStartEndAngle.description: Draws an arc between a start and an end point that sweeps the given included angle.

arc.addStartEndDirection.description: Draws an arc between a start and an end point that leaves the start point in the given tangent direction.

arc.addStartEndRadius.description: Draws an arc between a start and an end point with the given radius; a negative radius draws the major arc.

arrange.bringToFront.description: Moves the given objects, or the selection, to the front of the draw order.

arrange.group.description: Makes a named or anonymous group of the given objects, or the selection, and answers its name and members.

arrange.sendToBack.description: Moves the given objects, or the selection, to the back of the draw order.

arrange.ungroup.description: Dissolves the named groups, or every group holding one of the given or selected objects, and answers the groups removed.

attribute.define.description: Defines a block attribute with a tag, prompt and default value at a point, with optional height and invisibility.

attribute.display.description: Sets how attributes display (normal, all on or all off) through ATTMODE, and answers the new value.

attribute.edit.description: Sets attribute values on one block reference by tag, and answers which changed and which tags were unknown.

attribute.editGlobal.description: Finds and replaces text in attribute values across block references filtered by block, tag and value, and answers how many changed.

attribute.manage.description: Answers the attribute definitions of the named block (tag, prompt, default and invisibility), as the Block Attribute Manager lists them.

attribute.sync.description: Updates every reference of a block so its attributes match the block's current attribute definitions.

block.add.description: Defines a block from objects and a base point, then deletes the objects by default (or keeps or converts them), as -BLOCK does.

block.addDialog.description: Defines a block from objects and a base point, then converts the objects to a reference of it, keeps or deletes them.

block.insert.description: Inserts a block reference at a point with scale and rotation, defining the block from a DXF or DWG file first when one is given.

block.list.description: Answers every named block definition in the drawing with its name, base point, number of objects and description.

block.setBase.description: Sets the drawing's insertion base point ($INSBASE) used when it is inserted as a block.

block.write.description: Writes a block, or the given objects with a base point, to a new drawing file at a path.

boundary.add.description: Creates a closed polyline along the boundary of the area around each internal point.

calculator.open.description: Evaluates an arithmetic expression, with optional named variables, as QuickCalc does, and answers the result.

centerLine.add.description: Draws a centre line midway between two lines, on the CENTER linetype.

centerMark.add.description: Draws centre marks with centre lines on the CENTER linetype for the given circles and arcs.

circle.add.description: Draws a circle from a centre and radius or diameter, two diameter end points, or three points on it.

circle.addCenterDiameter.description: Draws a circle from its centre point and diameter.

circle.addTanTanRadius.description: Draws a circle of a given radius tangent to two lines, circles, arcs or polyline segments, the solution nearest the pick points.

circle.addTanTanTan.description: Draws a circle tangent to three lines, circles, arcs or polyline segments, the solution nearest the three pick points.

circle.addThreePoints.description: Draws the circle that passes through three points.

circle.addTwoPoints.description: Draws a circle whose diameter runs between two points.

command.list.description: Answers the commands the command line knows: each id with the name a person types for it, its aliases, its title, its menu path, whether it asks for its input in prompts, and whether the command line may start it; `search` keeps the commands whose id, name, title or an alias contains it.

command.runLine.description: Runs a line typed at the command line: a command name or alias with its prompts' answers, as the person types them.

constraint.addDimensional.description: Adds a dimensional constraint (linear, aligned, horizontal, vertical, angular, radius or diameter) with a value or expression and re-solves.

constraint.addGeometric.description: Adds a geometric constraint of a given type between points or objects and re-solves the drawing's constraints.

constraint.auto.description: Infers and adds geometric constraints among the given or selected objects within distance and angle tolerances, of the chosen types.

constraint.bars.description: Shows or hides the constraint bars of the given objects, or of every object.

constraint.coincident.description: Constrains two points, or a point and an object, to coincide, and re-solves the constraints.

constraint.collinear.description: Constrains two lines or segments to lie on the same infinite line, and re-solves the constraints.

constraint.concentric.description: Constrains two arcs, circles or ellipses to share a centre, and re-solves the constraints.

constraint.delete.description: Deletes the constraints on the given or selected objects, or the constraints with the given ids.

constraint.dimensionAligned.description: Adds an aligned distance constraint between two points or along a line, with a value or expression, and re-solves.

constraint.dimensionAngular.description: Adds an angular constraint between two lines or on an arc, with a value or expression in degrees, and re-solves.

constraint.dimensionDiameter.description: Adds a diameter constraint to an arc or circle, with a value or expression, and re-solves.

constraint.dimensionHorizontal.description: Adds a horizontal distance constraint between two points, with a value or expression, and re-solves.

constraint.dimensionLinear.description: Adds a horizontal or vertical distance constraint between two points, with a value or expression, and re-solves.

constraint.dimensionRadius.description: Adds a radius constraint to an arc or circle, with a value or expression, and re-solves.

constraint.dimensionVertical.description: Adds a vertical distance constraint between two points, with a value or expression, and re-solves.

constraint.dynamicDimensions.description: Shows or hides the dynamic dimensional constraints of the given objects, or of every object.

constraint.equal.description: Constrains two lines to equal length, or two arcs or circles to equal radius, and re-solves the constraints.

constraint.fix.description: Fixes a point or an object in place so the constraint solver cannot move it.

constraint.hideAllBars.description: Hides the constraint bars of every constrained object.

constraint.hideAllDynamicDimensions.description: Hides every dynamic dimensional constraint in the drawing.

constraint.horizontal.description: Constrains a line, segment or pair of points to stay horizontal, and re-solves the constraints.

constraint.inspect.description: Answers the drawing's constraints, their glyph anchors, the parameters, the constraint settings and whether everything is satisfied.

constraint.parallel.description: Constrains two lines or polyline segments to stay parallel, and re-solves the constraints.

constraint.parameters.description: Lists the constraint parameters, sets one by name to a value or expression (creating a user parameter), or deletes one, then re-solves.

constraint.perpendicular.description: Constrains two lines or polyline segments to stay perpendicular, and re-solves the constraints.

constraint.settings.description: Sets constraint inference, distance and angle tolerances, auto-constrain types, and constraint bar and dimension visibility.

constraint.showAllBars.description: Shows the constraint bars of every constrained object.

constraint.showAllDynamicDimensions.description: Shows every dynamic dimensional constraint in the drawing.

constraint.smooth.description: Constrains a spline to join another curve with smooth (curvature) continuity, and re-solves the constraints.

constraint.symmetric.description: Constrains two points or objects to stay symmetric about a symmetry line, and re-solves the constraints.

constraint.tangent.description: Constrains a curve to stay tangent to another curve or line, and re-solves the constraints.

constraint.vertical.description: Constrains a line, segment or pair of points to stay vertical, and re-solves the constraints.

constructionLine.add.description: Draws an infinite construction line through two points, at an angle, horizontal or vertical, bisecting an angle, or offset from a line.

dimension.add.description: Draws a dimension between two points with its line at a point, choosing the dimension kind from the geometry.

dimension.addAligned.description: Draws a dimension parallel to the line between two points, its dimension line through a point, with optional override text.

dimension.addAngular.description: Draws an angular dimension from a vertex and two points, between two lines, or for an arc, with its arc through a point.

dimension.addArcLength.description: Draws an arc length dimension for an arc or polyline arc segment, its line through a point.

dimension.addBaseline.description: Draws linear dimensions from the first extension line of the last linear dimension to each of the given points, spaced apart.

dimension.addContinue.description: Draws linear dimensions that continue end to end from the last linear dimension to each of the given points.

dimension.addDiameter.description: Draws a diameter dimension for an arc or circle, or from a centre and a point on the curve.

dimension.addLinear.description: Draws a horizontal, vertical or rotated linear dimension between two points, or an associative one for an object, with the line at a point.

dimension.addOrdinate.description: Draws an ordinate dimension giving a feature point's x or y datum value, with its leader to a point.

dimension.addQuick.description: Draws a continuous series of linear dimensions across the end points of the given objects, horizontal or vertical, at a point.

dimension.addRadius.description: Draws a radius dimension for an arc or circle, or from a centre and a point on the curve.

dimension.disassociate.description: Removes the associativity of the given dimensions so they no longer follow their objects.

dimension.editText.description: Moves the text of the given dimensions to a point, or sets it home, to an angle, left, centre or right.

dimension.override.description: Overrides dimension style fields or DIM variables on the given dimensions, or clears their overrides, and can set override text.

dimension.reassociate.description: Reassociates the given dimensions so their definition points attach to the objects under them.

dimension.space.description: Spaces parallel linear or angular dimensions evenly from a base dimension, by the given spacing or DIMDLI.

dimension.textAngle.description: Rotates the text of the given dimensions to an angle in degrees.

dimension.textCenter.description: Centres the text of the given dimensions on the dimension line.

dimension.textHome.description: Moves the text of the given dimensions back to its default position and angle.

dimension.textLeft.description: Moves the text of the given linear dimensions towards the left extension line.

dimension.textRight.description: Moves the text of the given linear dimensions towards the right extension line.

dimension.updateStyle.description: Applies the current dimension style to the given dimensions, or the selected ones, removing their overrides.

dimensionStyle.delete.description: Deletes a dimension style that is not Standard, current or used by any dimension.

dimensionStyle.list.description: Answers the dimension styles and the current one, and every variable of the named style when one is given.

dimensionStyle.open.description: Creates or changes a dimension style from style fields or DIM variables, and by default makes it current; answers the styles.

dimensionStyle.openManager.description: Creates or changes a dimension style from style fields or DIM variables, and by default makes it current, from the Dimension menu.

dimensionStyle.override.description: Sets per-dimension overrides of style fields or DIM variables on the given dimensions, or clears them.

dimensionStyle.rename.description: Renames a dimension style from one name to another.

dimensionStyle.setCurrent.description: Makes the named dimension style the current one for new dimensions.

donut.add.description: Draws a filled ring as a wide closed polyline, from a centre and inside and outside diameters.

drafting.dynamicInput.description: Turns dynamic input on or off, or toggles it with no value, and answers the new state; the drawing is unchanged.

drafting.grid.description: Turns the grid display on or off, or toggles it with no value, and answers the new state; the drawing is unchanged.

drafting.isometric.description: Turns isometric drafting on or off, or toggles it with no value, and answers the new state.

drafting.lineweightDisplay.description: Turns the display of lineweights on or off, or toggles it with no value, and answers the new state.

drafting.objectSnap.description: Turns running object snaps on or off and sets their modes by name or OSMODE bits; answers the state and the active modes.

drafting.objectSnapTracking.description: Turns object snap tracking on or off, or toggles it with no value, and answers the new state; the drawing is unchanged.

drafting.ortho.description: Turns ortho mode on or off, or toggles it with no value, and answers the new state; the drawing is unchanged.

drafting.polar.description: Turns polar tracking on or off, or toggles it with no value, and answers the new state; the drawing is unchanged.

drafting.quickProperties.description: Turns the Quick Properties palette on or off, or toggles it with no value, and answers the new state.

drafting.selectionCycling.description: Turns selection cycling of overlapping objects on or off, or toggles it with no value, and answers the new state.

drafting.setDynamicEntry.description: Tells the engine what the person has typed in the editor's dynamic input boxes beside the cursor, so a value locked there holds the cursor and the preview, and answers whether the text reads as a box entry and the command-line text Enter would send for it now (`complete`; null sends the text as typed). The editor calls it; it changes neither the drawing nor the running command.

drafting.settings.description: Sets drafting settings (snap and grid spacing, polar angle, major grid lines) and answers every drafting setting.

drafting.snap.description: Turns snap mode on or off, or toggles it with no value, and answers the new state; the drawing is unchanged.

drafting.transparencyDisplay.description: Turns the display of object transparency on or off, or toggles it with no value, and answers the new state.

edit.copy.description: Copies the given objects, or the selection, to the clipboard with their own coordinates; the drawing is unchanged.

edit.copyWithBasePoint.description: Copies the given objects, or the selection, to the clipboard with a base point that a later paste places; the drawing is unchanged.

edit.cut.description: Copies the given objects, or the selection, to the clipboard and erases them from the drawing.

edit.delete.description: Erases every selected object from the drawing, as Edit > Clear does.

edit.deselectAll.description: Clears the selection so no object is selected, and answers the selection count.

edit.find.description: Finds text in the text, mtext, attributes and dimensions of the current space, optionally replacing it, matching case or whole words.

edit.paste.description: Pastes the clipboard's objects into the current space, putting their base point at the given point or at their original coordinates.

edit.pasteAsBlock.description: Pastes the clipboard's objects as one new anonymous block reference inserted at the given point or at their original coordinates.

edit.pasteToOriginalCoordinates.description: Pastes the clipboard's objects at their original coordinates into a drawing other than the one they were copied from.

edit.redo.description: Redoes the last undone step of the caller's undo scope, or of the given person or agent scope.

edit.redoStep.description: Redoes the last count undone steps of the caller's undo scope, or of the given person or agent scope.

edit.selectAll.description: Selects every selectable object in the current space and answers how many are selected.

edit.undo.description: Undoes the last step of the caller's undo scope, or of the given person or agent scope (KitModel M12a).

edit.undoMany.description: Undoes the last count steps of the caller's undo scope, or of the given person or agent scope.

edit.undoStep.description: Undoes the last step of the caller's undo scope (person or agent), as the U command does.

ellipse.add.description: Draws an ellipse, or an elliptical arc with start and end angles, from a centre, a major axis vector and a minor-to-major ratio.

ellipse.addArc.description: Draws an elliptical arc between start and end angles, from a centre, major axis and ratio or from axis end points and a distance.

ellipse.addAxisEnd.description: Draws an ellipse from the two end points of one axis and half the length of the other, as a distance or a third point.

file.audit.description: Checks the drawing's database for errors (dangling references, bad handles, invalid tables) and, with fix, repairs them; answers each issue found.

file.bytes.description: Answers the current drawing written as DXF, base64-encoded, without saving it to a file.

file.close.description: Closes the drawing at the given document index, or the current one, without saving it.

file.closeAll.description: Closes every open drawing without saving, leaving no current document.

file.export.description: Exports the drawing as a PDF, SVG or PNG file: model space framed to its extents (a PDF fitted to its page's paper). Answers the file as base64 `data`, without saving the drawing or changing it.

file.exportPdf.description: Exports a layout or model space to PDF, on a paper and orientation, fitted or not, to a path or answered as base64.

file.inspect.description: Answers an overview of the drawing: object counts by type, layers, blocks, styles, current settings and, optionally, a page of its objects.

file.new.description: Opens a new empty drawing as a further document and makes it current: in millimetres with ISO-25 dimensions, as a new document is, or in inches with metric false.

file.open.description: Opens a DXF or DWG drawing, from a path or from base64 data with a name, as a further document and makes it current.

file.print.description: Plots a layout or model space to PDF, on a paper and orientation, at a scale or fitted, written to a path or answered as base64.

file.purge.description: Removes unused named items of one or every type (blocks, layers, styles and more) and zero-length or empty objects, matching names.

file.recover.description: Opens a damaged drawing from a path or base64 data, repairs what audit finds, and answers the new document's index with the issues fixed.

file.save.description: Saves the current drawing to its own file, or to the given path, in the format the file name says.

file.saveAs.description: Saves the current drawing to a new path as DXF or DWG and makes that path the drawing's file.

file.setLimits.description: Sets the drawing limits of model space from a lower-left and an upper-right corner.

file.setUnits.description: Sets the drawing's length and angle unit formats and precisions, and its insertion units.

file.status.description: Answers a text report of the drawing's object count, limits, extents, current layer and settings, as STATUS prints it.

file.switch.description: Makes the open drawing at the given document index the current one.

file.time.description: Answers the drawing's revision and the number of edits recorded in this session as a message.

grip.mirror.description: Mirrors the given objects about the line from a base point or grip to a second point, optionally copying them.

grip.move.description: Stretches one grip of the given objects to a point, or with mode move moves the objects from a grip, optionally copying them.

grip.rotate.description: Rotates the given objects about a base point or a grip, by an angle or towards a point, optionally copying them.

grip.scale.description: Scales the given objects about a base point or a grip, by a factor or towards a point, optionally copying them.

grip.stretch.description: Stretches the grip at an index of the given objects to a target point, as dragging a grip does.

group.edit.description: Adds objects to a group, removes them, or renames it, and answers its members; removing every member deletes the group.

group.list.description: Answers every group in the drawing with its name, description, selectability, whether it is unnamed, and its member handles.

hatch.add.description: Fills areas around internal points, or inside closed objects, with a hatch pattern at a scale and angle, optionally associative.

hatch.addGradient.description: Fills areas around internal points, or inside closed objects, with a two-colour gradient at an angle.

hatch.edit.description: Changes the pattern, scale or angle of the given hatches, or the selected ones.

helix.add.description: Draws a helix as a 3D polyline from a centre, base and top radii, height, number of turns and twist direction.

layer.add.description: Creates a layer with a name and optional colour, linetype and lineweight, optionally making it current.

layer.allOn.description: Turns every layer in the drawing on.

layer.changeToCurrent.description: Moves the given objects, or the selection, onto the current layer.

layer.delete.description: Deletes the named layer when it is empty and is not layer 0, Defpoints or the current layer.

layer.deleteWithObjects.description: Deletes the named layers together with every object on them.

layer.freeze.description: Freezes the layers of the given objects, or the selection.

layer.isolate.description: Isolates the layers of the given objects, or the selection, by turning every other layer off.

layer.lock.description: Locks the layers of the given objects, or the selection, so their objects cannot be edited.

layer.makeObjectCurrent.description: Makes the layer of the given object, or the selected one, the current layer.

layer.match.description: Moves the given objects, or the selection, onto the named layer.

layer.merge.description: Moves the objects on the from layers onto a target layer, then deletes the from layers.

layer.off.description: Turns off the layers of the given objects, or the selection.

layer.open.description: Answers every layer with its properties, whether it is current and in use, and the saved layer states, as the Layer Properties Manager shows.

layer.previous.description: Undoes the last change to layer settings, restoring the previous layer state.

layer.set.description: Changes a layer's properties: on, frozen, locked, plot, colour, linetype, lineweight, transparency, description, plot style, or name.

layer.setCurrent.description: Makes the named layer current, so new objects are drawn on it.

layer.thawAll.description: Thaws every frozen layer in the drawing.

layer.unisolate.description: Restores the layers turned off by the last layer isolate.

layer.unlock.description: Unlocks the layers of the given objects, or the selection.

layerState.delete.description: Deletes the named saved layer state.

layerState.list.description: Answers the names of the saved layer states, with a message line.

layerState.rename.description: Renames a saved layer state from one name to another.

layerState.restore.description: Restores the layer settings saved in the named layer state.

layerState.save.description: Saves every layer's current settings as a named layer state.

layout.add.description: Creates a paper space layout with a name, by default with one viewport, and answers its name and viewport.

layout.delete.description: Deletes the named paper space layout.

layout.duplicate.description: Copies a layout with its page setup and viewports to a new layout name.

layout.list.description: Answers every layout with its name, tab order, whether it is current, its page setup and its viewports.

layout.manage.description: Creates, copies, deletes, renames, sets or lists paper space layouts, with the option prompts of LAYOUT.

layout.rename.description: Renames a layout, by default the current one, to a new name.

layout.set.description: Switches to model space or to the named paper space layout tab.

leader.add.description: Draws a leader line through the given points, with optional annotation text at its end.

line.add.description: Draws connected line segments through the given points, closing back to the first point when closed is set.

measure.angle.description: Measures the angle at a vertex between two points, or between two lines, in degrees.

measure.area.description: Measures the area and perimeter of a closed polygon through points, or of a closed object.

measure.distance.description: Measures the distance between two points and answers it with the angle and the x and y deltas.

measure.geometry.description: Measures a distance, a radius, an angle or an area, taking the parameters of measure.distance, measure.radius, measure.angle or measure.area.

output.description: the answer of measure.distance, measure.radius, measure.angle or measure.area for the mode

measure.massProperties.description: Answers the area, perimeter, centroid and moments of inertia of each given or selected closed object.

measure.point.description: Answers the coordinates of a point, as the ID command reports them.

measure.radius.description: Answers the radius and diameter of an arc or circle.

multileader.add.description: Draws a multileader from an arrow point through vertices to a landing, with mtext or a block, straight, spline or no leader.

multileaderStyle.open.description: Creates or changes a multileader style's arrow size, text height and style, landing gap and dogleg, optionally making it current.

multiline.add.description: Draws a multiline as two parallel offset polylines through the points, with scale, justification and an optional close.

multilineText.add.description: Draws multiline text at a point with optional height, wrap width, attachment, rotation, style and line spacing.

namedObject.rename.description: Renames a named item (layer, linetype, text style, dimension style, block, multileader or table style, view or UCS).

object.align.description: Moves and rotates objects so one or two source points meet destination points, optionally scaling them to fit.

object.array.description: Copies objects in a rectangular, polar or path array, taking the parameters of arrayrect, arraypolar or arraypath.

object.arrayPath.description: Copies the given objects, or the selection, along a path object, a count of copies or at a spacing, optionally aligned to it.

object.arrayPolar.description: Copies the given objects, or the selection, a number of times about a centre over an angle, optionally rotating them.

object.arrayRectangular.description: Copies the given objects, or the selection, into a grid of rows and columns at the given spacings.

object.blend.description: Draws a spline that joins the picked ends of two open curves with tangent or smooth continuity.

object.break.description: Removes the part of an object between two points on it, splitting it in two or shortening it.

object.breakAtPoint.description: Splits an object into two at one point, leaving no gap.

object.chamfer.description: Bevels the corner between two lines by two distances or a length and angle, optionally trimming, or chamfers every polyline corner.

object.changeSpace.description: Moves the given objects between model space and a layout's paper space through a viewport, keeping their apparent size.

object.copy.description: Copies the given objects, or the selection, by a delta or from a point to a point, once or count times.

object.copyNested.description: Copies objects nested inside a block reference, the one nearest a pick or all, out into the drawing by a delta or points.

object.count.description: Counts block references in model space, every block or the named one, and answers the counts with a message line.

object.delete.description: Erases the given objects, or the selection, from the drawing.

object.deleteDuplicates.description: Deletes duplicate and overlapping objects among the given ones, or the selection.

object.explode.description: Breaks the given compound objects (blocks, polylines, dimensions, hatches), or the selection, into their component objects.

object.extend.description: Extends an object to its boundary edges at the end that is picked, fenced or crossed.

object.fillet.description: Joins two lines, arcs or circles with a tangent arc of a radius, optionally trimming them, or fillets every polyline corner.

object.flatten.description: Flattens the given objects, or the selection, onto z = 0, turning 3D polylines into 2D polylines.

object.join.description: Joins the given lines, arcs, polylines or splines that meet end to end into single objects.

object.lengthen.description: Changes an object's length at the picked end by a delta, percent, total or to a point, or alone measures its length.

object.list.description: Answers a text listing of the given or selected objects' database properties, as the LIST command prints them.

object.matchProperties.description: Copies the layer, colour, linetype, lineweight and other properties of a source object onto the target objects.

object.measure.description: Measures without changing anything: each entity's bounding box (`bounds`: handles), the minimum distance between two entities or points with the nearest points (`distance`: [a, b], each a handle or [x, y]), the points where two entities cross (`intersections`: [a, b] handles), or the pairs of duplicate objects in a space (`overlaps`: {layout?}, Model unless named; OVERKILL's report, nothing deleted). Give exactly one.

overlaps.description: the space to report duplicates in

object.mirror.description: Mirrors the given objects, or the selection, about the line through two points, optionally erasing the originals.

object.move.description: Moves the given objects, or the selection, by a delta or from a base point to a target point.

object.offset.description: Creates a copy of an object offset by a distance towards a side point, on the source or current layer, optionally erasing it.

object.properties.description: Answers the properties of the given objects, or the selection: type, handle, layer, colour, linetype, bounds and geometry.

object.query.description: Answers a page of objects of one space (Model, or a layout by `layout`, without going there; default the space shown) filtered by type, layer and a crossing or inside window, with their handles, properties and geometry and the total count.

object.reverse.description: Reverses the vertex order of the given lines, polylines, 3D polylines and splines.

object.rotate.description: Rotates the given objects, or the selection, about a base point by an angle in degrees, optionally keeping the originals.

object.scale.description: Scales the given objects, or the selection, about a base point by a factor, optionally keeping the originals.

object.setProperties.description: Sets properties of the given objects, or the selection: layer, colour, linetype, lineweight, scale, transparency, visibility and geometry fields.

object.stretch.description: Moves the vertices inside a crossing window by a delta, stretching the objects that cross it and moving those wholly inside.

object.trim.description: Trims an object at its cutting edges where it is picked, fenced or crossed, in quick or standard mode.

plot.pageSetup.description: Sets a layout's page setup: paper, orientation, margins, plot area, scale or fit, centring, lineweights and plot style table.

plot.style.description: Sets the named plot style of the given or selected objects, or the current one for new objects; with no name reports it.

plot.styleManager.description: Lists, reads, creates, changes, deletes, loads or saves plot style tables (colour-dependent .ctb or named .stb) and their styles.

point.add.description: Draws a point object at a location, or one at each of the given points, in the current point style.

point.addMultiple.description: Draws a point object at each of the given points in the current point style.

point.divide.description: Places points or block references at equal intervals that split an object into the given number of segments, optionally aligned to it.

point.measure.description: Places points or block references along an object at every given length, from one end, optionally aligned to it.

point.style.description: Sets how point objects display (PDMODE) and their size (PDSIZE).

polygon.add.description: Draws a regular closed polygon with the given number of sides, inscribed in or circumscribed about a circle, or from one edge.

polyline.add.description: Draws one lightweight polyline through the vertices, each a point or a point with bulge and start and end widths, optionally closed.

polyline.add3d.description: Draws a 3D polyline of straight segments through points with optional z values, optionally closed.

polyline.edit.description: Edits polylines: close, open, join, width, fit, spline, decurve, reverse, linetype generation, or edit one vertex.

property.color.description: Sets the current colour for new objects: ByLayer, ByBlock, a colour name, an index 1 to 255 or an r,g,b triple.

property.linetype.description: Loads a linetype, or every one, from the built-in definitions, or sets the current linetype for new objects.

property.linetypeScale.description: Sets the drawing's global linetype scale factor (LTSCALE).

property.lineweight.description: Sets the current lineweight for new objects, in millimetres or ByLayer.

ray.add.description: Draws a semi-infinite ray starting at a base point and passing through a second point.

rectangle.add.description: Draws a closed rectangular polyline from two corners, dimensions or an area, with optional rotation, fillet or chamfer corners, width, elevation and thickness.

region.add.description: Converts the given closed objects, or the selection, into regions.

revisionCloud.add.description: Draws a revision cloud of arcs from a rectangle, a polygon, a freehand path or an existing object, with optional arc length and style.

revisionCloud.addFreehand.description: Draws a revision cloud of arcs along a freehand path through the given points.

revisionCloud.addPolygonal.description: Draws a revision cloud of arcs along the closed polygon through the given points.

select.quick.description: Selects objects by type and a property comparison (equals, differs, greater, less, wildcard), new, appended or excluded, over the drawing or the selection.

select.quickInfo.description: Answers the object types in the drawing or selection with their counts, and the properties and operators Quick Select offers for a type.

select.set.description: Sets or extends the selection by handles, a window or crossing box, or a pick point, or clears it; answers the selected handles.

spline.add.description: Draws a spline through fit points with optional end tangents, from control vertices, or converts a polyline into a spline.

spline.addControlVertices.description: Draws a spline from control vertices with the given degree (default 3), optionally closed.

spline.edit.description: Edits a spline: close, open, reverse, refit, purge fit data, convert to a polyline, or move a fit or control point.

table.add.description: Draws a table at a point with rows and columns, row height and column width, and optional cell texts, title and header row.

table.deleteColumn.description: Deletes one column of a table by its index.

table.deleteRow.description: Deletes one row of a table by its index.

table.insertColumn.description: Inserts a column into a table before a column, or appends one, with an optional width.

table.insertRow.description: Inserts a row into a table before a row, or appends one, with an optional height.

table.merge.description: Merges a block of table cells, from a row and column over a number of rows and columns, into one cell.

table.set.description: Sets the text of one cell of a table, by row and column.

table.unmerge.description: Splits the merged table cell at a row and column back into its single cells.

tableStyle.open.description: Creates or changes a table style's text height, cell margin, title and header rows, optionally making it current.

text.add.description: Draws single-line text at a point with optional height, rotation and justification, in the current text style.

text.edit.description: Replaces the contents of a text, mtext, attribute definition, or a dimension's override text.

textStyle.delete.description: Deletes a text style that is not Standard, current or used by any object.

textStyle.list.description: Answers every text style with its font, height, width factor, flags and whether it is current.

textStyle.open.description: Creates or changes a text style: font, big font, height, width factor, oblique angle, flags, annotative, and optionally makes it current.

textStyle.rename.description: Renames a text style from one name to another.

textStyle.setCurrent.description: Makes the named text style the current one for new text.

variable.get.description: Answers the value of the named system variable.

variable.list.description: Answers every system variable the drawing has, by name, with its value.

variable.set.description: Sets a system variable by name to a value, as SETVAR does.

view.get.description: Answers the current view's centre, visible height in drawing units and viewport size in pixels.

view.pan.description: Moves the view by a delta, from one point to another, or to a new centre, without changing the zoom.

view.panDown.description: Pans the view a step downwards.

view.panLeft.description: Pans the view a step to the left.

view.panRight.description: Pans the view a step to the right.

view.panUp.description: Pans the view a step upwards.

view.redraw.description: Repaints the current view to clear leftover marks; the drawing is unchanged.

view.regen.description: Regenerates the current viewport's display from the drawing data; the drawing is unchanged.

view.regenAll.description: Regenerates the display of every viewport from the drawing data; the drawing is unchanged.

view.set.description: Sets the view to a centre point and a visible height in drawing units.

view.zoomAll.description: Zooms the view to show the drawing limits and every object, whichever is larger.

view.zoomIn.description: Zooms the view in by a factor of two about its centre.

view.zoomObject.description: Zooms the view to fit the given objects, or the selection.

view.zoomOut.description: Zooms the view out by a factor of two about its centre.

view.zoomPrevious.description: Restores the view saved before the last zoom or pan, if there is one.

view.zoomRealtime.description: Changes the view: to extents, all, a window, the previous view, in or out, a centre and height, a scale factor, or objects.

view.zoomToFit.description: Zooms the view to fit the extents of every object in the current space.

view.zoomWindow.description: Zooms the view to fit the rectangle between two corner points.

viewport.add.description: Creates one to four viewports in a layout over two corners, by default the printable area, in an arrangement.

viewport.four.description: Creates four equal viewports on a layout over two corners, by default the printable area.

viewport.freezeLayer.description: Freezes or thaws layers and overrides layer colours in one layout viewport only.

viewport.modelSpace.description: Makes a layout viewport active so editing happens in model space through it, by handle or by a paper point inside it.

viewport.new.description: Creates one to four viewports on a layout in an arrangement, over two corners or the printable area.

viewport.one.description: Creates a single viewport on a layout over two corners, by default the printable area.

viewport.paperSpace.description: Leaves the active viewport so editing happens in the layout's paper space again.

viewport.set.description: Sets layout viewport properties: scale, view height and centre, lock, layer freeze and thaw, and per-layer colour overrides.

viewport.sync.description: Tells the engine the editor viewport's pan offset, zoom and pixel size, so its view matches what is drawn on screen.

viewport.three.description: Creates three viewports on a layout with the large one right, left, above or below, or in a row or column.

viewport.two.description: Creates two viewports on a layout side by side or stacked, over two corners or the printable area.

wipeout.add.description: Draws a wipeout that masks the objects behind it, from points or a closed polyline, or sets whether wipeout frames show.
